create_FullscreenQuadRenderer: create a FullscreenQuadRenderer instance to initialize OpenGL geometry, texture, and shaders for fullscreen quad rendering
render_pixmap_on_fullscreen_quad: render a numpy pixmap array onto a fullscreen quad with a given viewport shape using OpenGL
init_geometry_vertex_buffer: initialize the fullscreen quad geometry by creating and binding an OpenGL vertex buffer with vertex positions and texture coordinates
init_texture_storage: initialize OpenGL texture storage with nearest-neighbor filtering for mag and min filters
init_shaders_vertex_fragment: compile and link a vertex shader and fragment shader program for rendering textured fullscreen quads
